slides.title: Number of the Week
slides.body: The S&P 500 gained 3.9% through Wednesday, Nov 25, after an 8.6% drop the week before. On Wednesday alone it fell as much as 3.2%, then closed down just 0.3%.

slides.title: Story 2: Hot Inflation
slides.body: October PCE inflation ran 3.8% from a year earlier; core was 3.3%. Q3 growth was revised up to 4.3%. Futures price a December Fed hike at about 97%.
